season.evidence: Stored Jun-Oct. Web: Mountaineers describe the Standup Creek slopes as an early and late season option; Komoot lists late June to early October for Earl Peak; Bean/Beverly creek crossings run high in May-June. Peak-wide logged ascents are heaviest May-July.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Starts on the North Fork Teanaway road near Beverly and follows the Bean Creek approach to the southwest ridge.
Beverly Creek trailhead, Bean Creek approach, combined with Bean Peak.
Logged 'South ridge' from the Beverly Creek trailhead (47.389,-120.872): the Bean Creek approach, not Standup Creek.

May 2014 'East Slope' from a start east of Earl (47.398,-120.802) that fits the east-side Standup/Stafford area, but the track continues over other peaks (link-up) and May is a month before the window; no assignment.
Bean Creek Trail, October 2022; wrong approach.

notes: Our catalog also holds Earl Peak's Southwest Ridge (already tracked); every harvested summit track uses the Beverly/Bean Creek approach, so none documents the Standup Creek route. Several logged routes (Stafford Creek - Standup trail - East/SE ridge, June, Aug) match our route but have no harvested track. The route has no trailhead pin; none proposed (no round-trip track from that trailhead to confirm).
